title: Filtering the customers table by text · part 3

steps.title: Keep rows where email is user6@shop.ma
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like 'user6@shop.ma'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email = 'user6@shop.ma';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email = 'user6@shop.ma';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email = 'user6@shop.ma';
